# Format reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

A project is a directory of JSON Lines files: one record per line, each with its kind in `"$k"` ([doc 05](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/05-project-format-and-persistence.md)). This reference lists the 53 record kinds of format 0.1, from [`schemas/0.1/index.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/schemas/0.1/index.json): the file that holds each kind, its rank (the order of records within a file) and its status. Each kind with a schema has a page with its fields; a reserved kind has no schema yet. The JSON Schemas themselves are in [`schemas/0.1`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/tree/main/schemas/0.1).
